name: Weird Cities
source:
Years ago, Jane hurt Berlin, leaving scars that never fully healed. Now Berlin has returned, Kristine hides a secret, and Jane must confront the past, navigate complicated friendships, and decide if forgiveness is possible.

[From [url=https://cecilyrenns.itch.io/weird-cities]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多年前，简伤害了柏林，留下了从未完全愈合的伤疤。现在柏林回来了，克里斯汀隐藏了一个秘密，简必须面对过去，处理复杂的友谊，并决定是否可以原谅。

[来自[url=https://cecilyrenns.itch.io/weird-cities]Itch.io[/url]]
